title: What's the purpose of gaining knowledge?

sentences.en: A. 'I would found an institution where any person can find instruction in any subject.
sentences.zh: A. '我会建立一个机构,任何人都可以在其中找到任何学科的指导。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: That was the founder's motto for Cornell University, and it seems an apt characterization of the different university, also in the USA, where I currently teach philosophy.
sentences.zh: 这是康奈尔大学创始人的座右铭,这似乎是对另一所大学的恰当描述,这所大学也在美国,我目前在那里教授哲学。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: A student can prepare for a career in resort management, engineering, interior design, accounting, music, law enforcement, you name it.
sentences.zh: 学生可以为度假村管理、工程、室内设计、会计、音乐、执法等领域的职业做好准备。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: But what would the founders of these two institutions have thought of a course called 'Arson for Profit'?
sentences.zh: 但是,这两个机构的创始人会如何看待名为“纵火营利”的课程呢？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: I kid you not: we have it on the books.
sentences.zh: 我没有骗你：我们在书上有它。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Any undergraduates who have met the academic requirements can sign up for the course in our program in 'fire science.
sentences.zh: 任何符合学术要求的本科生都可以报名参加我们的“火灾科学”课程。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: B. Naturally, the course is intended for prospective arson investigators, who can learn all the tricks of the trade for detecting whether a fire was deliberately set, discovering who did it, and establishing a chain of evidence for effective prosecution in a court of law.
sentences.zh: B. 当然,该课程是为未来的纵火调查人员准备的,他们可以学习所有的技巧,以检测是否故意纵火,发现谁纵火,并建立一系列证据以便在法庭上进行有效起诉。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: But wouldn't this also be the perfect course for prospective arsonists to sign up for?
sentences.zh: 但这不也是未来纵火犯报名的完美课程吗？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: My point is not to criticize academic programs in fire science: they are highly welcome as part of the increasing professionalization of this and many other occupations.
sentences.zh: 我的观点不是批评消防科学的学术项目：作为消防科学和许多其他职业日益专业化的一部分,它们受到高度欢迎。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, it's not unknown for a firefighter to torch a building.
sentences.zh: 然而,消防员纵火焚烧建筑物的情况并不罕见。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This example suggests how dishonest and illegal behavior, with the help of higher education, can creep into every aspect of public and business life.
sentences.zh: 这个例子表明,不诚实和非法行为如何在高等教育的帮助下渗透到公共和商业生活的各个方面。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C. I realized this anew when I was invited to speak before a class in marketing, which is another of our degree programs.
sentences.zh: C. 当我被邀请在市场营销课上演讲时,我重新意识到了这一点,这是我们的另一个学位课程。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The regular instructor is a colleague who appreciates the kind of ethical perspective 1 can bring as a philosopher.
sentences.zh: 常规导师是一位同事,他欣赏 1 作为哲学家可以带来的道德观点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: There are endless ways I could have approached this assignment, but I took my cue from the title of the course: 'Principles of Marketing. It made me think to ask the students, 'Is marketing principled?'
sentences.zh: 我可以用无数种方法来完成这项任务,但我从课程的标题中得到了暗示：“营销原理”。这让我想到要问学生们,“营销有原则吗？”

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: After all, a subject matter can have principles in the sense of being codified, having rules, as with football or chess, without being principled in the sense of being ethical.
sentences.zh: 毕竟,一个主题可以有被编纂意义上的原则,有规则,就像足球或国际象棋一样,但没有道德意义上的原则。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Many of the students immediately assumed that the answer to my question about marketing principles was obvious: no.
sentences.zh: 许多学生立即认为我关于营销原则的问题的答案是显而易见的：不。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Just look at the ways in which everything under the sun has been marketed; obviously it need not be done in a principled (=ethical) fashion.
sentences.zh: 只要看看天底下一切的营销方式就知道了；显然,这不需要以有原则（=道德）的方式完成。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: D. Is that obvious?
sentences.zh: D. 这很明显吗？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: I made the suggestion, which may sound downright crazy in light of the evidence, that perhaps marketing is by definition principled.
sentences.zh: 我提出了这个建议,鉴于证据,这可能听起来完全疯狂,也许营销从定义上来说是有原则的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: My inspiration for this judgement is the philosopher Immanuel Kant, who argued that any body of knowledge consists of an end (or purpose) and a means.
sentences.zh: 我这个判断的灵感来自哲学家伊曼努尔·康德,他认为任何知识体系都由目的（或目的）和手段组成。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: E. Let us apply both the terms 'means' and 'end' to marketing.
sentences.zh: E. 让我们将术语“手段”和“目的”应用于营销。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The students have signed up for a course in order to learn how to market effectively.
sentences.zh: 学生们报名参加了一门课程,以学习如何有效营销。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But to what end?
sentences.zh: 但目的是什么？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There seem to be two main attitudes toward that question.
sentences.zh: 对于这个问题似乎有两种主要态度。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: One is that the answer is obvious: the purpose of marketing is to sell things and to make money.
sentences.zh: 其一,答案很明显：营销的目的是卖东西、赚钱。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The other attitude is that the purpose of marketing is irrelevant: Each person comes to the program and course with his or her own plans, and these need not even concern the acquisition of marketing expertise as such.
sentences.zh: 另一种态度是,营销的目的无关紧要：每个人都有自己的计划来参加课程和课程,这些计划甚至不需要涉及营销专业知识的获取。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: My proposal, which I believe would also be Kant's, is that neither of these attitudes captures the significance of the end to the means for marketing.
sentences.zh: 我的建议（我相信这也将是康德的建议）是,这两种态度都没有抓住营销手段的目的的重要性。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A field of knowledge or a professional endeavor is defined by both the means and the end; hence both deserve scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 知识领域或专业努力是由手段和目的来定义的；因此两者都值得仔细审查。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Students need to study both how to achieve X, and also what X is.
sentences.zh: 学生需要研究如何实现X,以及X是什么。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F. It is at this point that 'Arson for Profit' becomes supremely relevant.
sentences.zh: F. 正是在这一点上,“谋利纵火”变得至关重要。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: That course is presumably all about means: how to detect and prosecute criminal activity.
sentences.zh: 该课程大概都是关于手段：如何侦查和起诉犯罪活动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It is therefore assumed that the end is good in an ethical sense.
sentences.zh: 因此,从伦理意义上来说,结局是好的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: When I ask fire science students to articulate the end, or purpose, of their field, they eventually generalize to something like, ‘The safety and welfare of society’, which seems right.
sentences.zh: 当我要求消防科学专业的学生阐明其领域的目的或目的时,他们最终概括为“社会的安全和福利”,这似乎是正确的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: As we have seen, someone could use the very same knowledge of means to achieve a much less noble end, such as personal profit via destructive, dangerous, reckless activity.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所看到的,有人可以利用同样的手段知识来达到不太崇高的目的,例如通过破坏性的、危险的、鲁莽的活动来获取个人利益。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But we would not call that firefighting.
sentences.zh: 但我们不会称之为救火。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: We have a separate word for it: arson.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个单独的词来形容它：纵火。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Similarly, if you employed the 'principles of marketing in an unprincipled way, you would not be doing marketing.
sentences.zh: 同样,如果你无原则地运用“营销原理”,你就不是在做营销。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: We have another term for it: fraud.
sentences.zh: 我们有另一个术语：欺诈。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Kant gives the example of a doctor and a poisoner, who use the identical knowledge to achieve their divergent ends.
sentences.zh: 康德举了一个医生和投毒者的例子,他们使用相同的知识来达到不同的目的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: We would say that one is practicing medicine, the other, murder.
sentences.zh: 我们会说一个是行医,另一个是谋杀。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。
